description: Search scores — Search scores with structured JSON filters. `filters` is an AND-list of predicates (`{field, operator, value}`) and one-level OR-groups (`{or: [...]}`) over the score fields: name, score, source, user_id, resource_id, label, created_at. Membership (`in`, `notIn`) and range (`between`) operators are supported; valid fields and operators are machine-readable at `GET /v1/filter-schema`. Defaults to the last 7 days when `start_date` is unset; the maximum search window is 90 days.
name: search_scores
